GRADE 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERM 3 EXAM

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Love at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. recognise that God loves children; Matthew 19:13-15,
   B. Learners should ignore Love completely.
   C. Love is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Love.

2. About Love at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. demonstrate love by showing kindness to others,
   B. Learners should ignore Love completely.
   C. Love is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Love.

3. About Love when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. recognise that God loves children; Matthew 19:13-15,
   B. Learners should ignore Love completely.
   C. Love is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Love.

5. About Responsibility Personal and school items at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify personal items and how they care for them,
   B. Learners should ignore Responsibility Personal and school items completely.
   C. Responsibility Personal and school items is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Responsibility Personal and school items.

6. About Responsibility Personal and school items at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. identify school properties and how they care for them,
   B. Learners should ignore Responsibility Personal and school items completely.
   C. Responsibility Personal and school items is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Responsibility Personal and school items.

7. About Responsibility Personal and school items when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. identify personal items and how they care for them,
   B. Learners should ignore Responsibility Personal and school items completely.
   C. Responsibility Personal and school items is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Responsibility Personal and school items.

9. About Holiness at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. describe ways of glorifying God with their bodies,
   B. Learners should ignore Holiness completely.
   C. Holiness is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Holiness.

10. About Holiness at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. acquire the value of holiness by keeping away from situations that lead to sin,
   B. Learners should ignore Holiness completely.
   C. Holiness is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Holiness.

11. About Holiness when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. recite 1Corinthians 6:19 on the body as the temple of the Holy Spirit,
   B. Learners should ignore Holiness completely.
   C. Holiness is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Holiness.

13. About House of God at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. outline lessons learnt from Matthew 21:12- 14,
   B. Learners should ignore House of God completely.
   C. House of God is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise House of God.

14. About House of God at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. participate in church activities to grow spiritually,
   B. Learners should ignore House of God completely.
   C. House of God is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise House of God.

15. About House of God when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. outline lessons learnt from Matthew 21:12- 14,
   B. Learners should ignore House of God completely.
   C. House of God is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise House of God.

17. About The Early Church at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. name the disciples of Jesus Christ,
   B. Learners should ignore The Early Church completely.
   C. The Early Church is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Early Church.

18. About The Early Church at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. describe how the early church was started,
   B. Learners should ignore The Early Church completely.
   C. The Early Church is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Early Church.

19. About The Early Church when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. name the disciples of Jesus Christ,
   B. Learners should ignore The Early Church completely.
   C. The Early Church is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Early Church.

21. About Standing Firm in Faith at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. name the city where believers were first called Christians,
   B. Learners should ignore Standing Firm in Faith completely.
   C. Standing Firm in Faith is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Standing Firm in Faith.

22. About Standing Firm in Faith at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. retell how Stephen was stoned for standing firm in his faith,
   B. Learners should ignore Standing Firm in Faith completely.
   C. Standing Firm in Faith is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Standing Firm in Faith.

23. About Standing Firm in Faith when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. list three lessons learnt from the stoning of Stephen,
   B. Learners should ignore Standing Firm in Faith completely.
   C. Standing Firm in Faith is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Standing Firm in Faith.

25. About The Lord’s Prayer at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. recite the Lord’s prayer
   B. Learners should ignore The Lord’s Prayer completely.
   C. The Lord’s Prayer is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Lord’s Prayer.

26. About The Lord’s Prayer at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. pray for parents, guardians and friends,
   B. Learners should ignore The Lord’s Prayer completely.
   C. The Lord’s Prayer is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Lord’s Prayer.

27. About The Lord’s Prayer when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. recite the Lord’s prayer
   B. Learners should ignore The Lord’s Prayer completely.
   C. The Lord’s Prayer is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise The Lord’s Prayer.

29. About Fruit of the Holy Spirit at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. list the fruit of the Holy Spirit; Galatians 5:22- 23,
   B. Learners should ignore Fruit of the Holy Spirit completely.
   C. Fruit of the Holy Spirit is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Fruit of the Holy Spirit.

30. About Fruit of the Holy Spirit at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. describe how they apply the fruit of the Holy Spirit in their lives,
   B. Learners should ignore Fruit of the Holy Spirit completely.
   C. Fruit of the Holy Spirit is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Fruit of the Holy Spirit.

31. About Fruit of the Holy Spirit when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. list the fruit of the Holy Spirit; Galatians 5:22- 23,
   B. Learners should ignore Fruit of the Holy Spirit completely.
   C. Fruit of the Holy Spirit is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Fruit of the Holy Spirit.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Love at home with your family.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Responsibility Personal and school items at home with your family.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Holiness at home with your family.

16. Give two examples of how you can use House of God at home with your family.

20. Give two examples of how you can use The Early Church at home with your family.

24. Give two examples of how you can use Standing Firm in Faith at home with your family.

28. Give two examples of how you can use The Lord’s Prayer at home with your family.

32. Give two examples of how you can use Fruit of the Holy Spirit at home with your family.
